notes.subject: שתם העין
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS 'matlho a bulegile' kgatlhanong le ASL/YLT 'matlho a tswaletse' — štum e ka bo e re go bula kgotsa go tswala; mo tlhaloganyong ya Setswana go latotswe 'a sa buegang'.

notes.subject: נאם...ונאם
notes.rationale: Go boela ga go bua ga bagaka gabedi (go bua ga Bileame / go bua ga monna) — sekgala se se agang seane.

notes.subject: seane
notes.rationale: משל ke seane kgotsa mokgwele wa bofilosofi; 'parabole' e ka baka tlhaloganyo e foletse.

translation: Mme Bileame o ne a tsenya ⟨את⟩ seane sa gagwe, mme a re: lefoko la Bileame, morwa wa Beore; mme lefoko la monna yo matlho a gagwe a sa buegang —

tokens.gloss: yo matlho a gagwe a sa buegang
